regions.region: page 1 title, abstract, introduction, author block, and ESI footnote
regions.finding: Article identity and aggregate one-pot CdI2/CuBr claim inspected. The footnote says ESI is available, but workspace mapping leaves SI association unestablished; no SI fact was imported.

Three prior-literature reaction-class arrows were retained separately: paraformaldehyde Crabbé chemistry, aldehyde-mediated 1,3-disubstituted allene synthesis, and CdI2-mediated ketone synthesis. They are literature examples, not experiments newly reported here.

Three prior-literature enantioselective approaches were retained separately, including the authors' earlier N-PINAP/CuBr filtration/ZnI2 two-pot method. No experiment-specific yield is assigned from this overview.

unresolved: Overview arrows aggregate cited papers and omit experiment-level scales, workups, purifications, masses, and yields.
Several structures contain generic R groups and remain label-only.

regions.region: page 2 left-center Table 1 reaction header, entries 1–7, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Seven CdI2-loading/temperature optimization rows were inspected. Entries 1–6 remain independent; entry 7 is merged with Table 2 entry 1. Shared scale, Cu/ligand/MS conditions, isolated yields, HPLC ee, footnote-d extra toluene, and footnote-e 2 h second step were applied row-wise.

regions.region: page 2 upper-right Table 2 reaction header, entries 1–12, and footnotes a–e
regions.finding: Twelve one-pot scope runs were retained, including the distinct 10 mmol entry 5 and the three (R,Sa)-N-PINAP rows 10–12. Entry 1 is the same 68%/97% standard experiment as Table 1 entry 7 and is not duplicated.
The prose introduces five Scheme 3 controls on page 3. Each filtration/metal/temperature condition is represented separately rather than merged with Table 2 rows.

unresolved: Optimization rows 1–6 omit exact masses, atmosphere, workup, purification, product mass, and detailed HPLC methods.
All candidate axial structures remain machine-unverified.

regions.finding: Five distinct current controls were retained: two ZnI2 filtration variants, simultaneous Cu/Cd formation of a low-ee propargylic amine, simultaneous Cu/Cd high-temperature allene formation, and the filtered CdI2 two-pot control. Product-specific yields and ee values remain separate.
Three (R,Ra)-N-PINAP one-pot experiments using racemic, (R)-, or (S)-1e were retained separately with combined yields, major/minor stereoisomers, HPLC ee values, and displayed diastereomer ratios.
Three analogous (R,Sa)-N-PINAP experiments were retained separately because starting-material chirality and product outcomes differ.
Four ZnI2/NaI two-pot current controls were retained separately. The 2.5/3.0 versus 5.0/5.5 mol% catalyst/ligand variants and racemic versus (R)-1e runs have distinct yields/ee/ratios.
The absolute-configuration drawing continues on page 4 and is classified as a proposed mechanism/model, not a preparation of its Cd intermediates.

unresolved: Scheme-only controls omit several scales, workups, purifications, isolated masses, and some yield/ee analytical bases.
Minor-isomer ee values printed as not determined remain qualitative rather than inferred.

regions.finding: The full proposed Cd/pyrrolidine cycle and Lowe–Brewster configuration model were inspected. Intermediates A/B are proposed and have no independent preparation or yield.

regions.region: page 4 left column Conclusions and General Information
regions.finding: Conclusions add no new experiment. General Schlenk/glove-box/reagent-handling context was inspected; it is not converted into independent reaction records or used to infer missing row-specific facts.

regions.region: page 4 right column Typical Procedure I for (Ra)-4aa
regions.finding: The standard Table 1 entry 7/Table 2 entry 1 record was enriched with exact masses/amounts, argon, catalyst pre-stirring, staged 25/90 °C times, TLC, no-filtration CdI2/toluene addition, workup, chromatography, 122.8 mg, 68% isolated yield, and 97% ee.
Exact quantities, 175.7 mg product, 84% yield, 93% ee, and 12:1 chromatography enrich Table 2 entry 2; characterization continues on page 5 and is not a duplicate preparation.

unresolved: General-information statements do not establish missing row-specific purity or analytical details.
Literature-comparison values marked ref. 12a are not substituted for current experimental outcomes.

regions.finding: Characterization continues the page-4/Table 2 entry 2 preparation and does not define another reaction.

regions.region: page 5 left column preparations of (Ra)-4ca and (Ra)-4da
regions.finding: Two distinct 1 mmol scope experiments enrich Table 2 entries 3 and 4 with exact quantities, isolated masses, purification, yield, ee, and the 47–49 °C melting point for 4da.
The 10 mmol scale experiment is Table 2 entry 5 and remains distinct from the 1 mmol entry 4; exact scaled quantities, 1483.3 mg, 67% yield, and 94% ee were retained.

regions.region: page 5 right column preparations of (Ra)-4db and (Ra)-4dc
regions.finding: Two separate aldehyde-scope experiments enrich Table 2 entries 6 and 7 with exact quantities, product masses, chromatographic eluents, yields, and ee values.
The 1d/octanal experiment begins here and continues on page 6; it is represented once with cross-page evidence as Table 2 entry 8.

unresolved: Spectroscopic characterization supports source labels but does not verify candidate SMILES or axial stereochemistry.

regions.finding: Completes Table 2 entry 8 with exact quantities, 125.2 mg product, 53% isolated yield, 92% ee, and 100:3 petroleum ether/ethyl acetate chromatography.
Table 2 entry 9 was enriched with exact quantities, 188.5 mg, 88% yield, 95% ee, purification, and 49–51 °C melting point.

regions.region: page 6 lower-left and right column preparations of (Sa)-4ba, (Sa)-4da, and (Sa)-4de
regions.finding: Three distinct (R,Sa)-N-PINAP runs enrich Table 2 entries 10–12 with exact quantities, product masses, yields, ee values, purifications, and the 45–47 °C melting point for (Sa)-4da.

regions.region: page 6 bottom-right statement assigning 4ee products to Typical Procedure I
regions.finding: The statement links Scheme 4/5 products to Typical Procedure I. It enriches those six existing records with procedure assignment but does not create duplicate preparations; their exact paragraph quantities continue after page 6 and remain outside this coverage claim.
